BiblicalUsage: The word is decease, death. Joseph and Mary were in Egypt until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my Son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the death of a tyrant is part of the prophecy, and the Son came out of Egypt on time.
